scope: Document docking compass and translucent gray placement preview; preserve unrelated post-sync repairs already present in the working tree.
implementation: Enable native directional docking for MDI document title drag handles without replacing document templates or pointer routing.
Decorate native DockTarget/GlobalDockTarget selectors with theme-bound plates, gray preview borders, and canonical Chinese strings localized by the existing live hook.

Nest document splits using the native CreateSplitLayout instead of flattening them into the sidebar's constrained horizontal parent; retain native splitters, ownership, capability validation, and events.

Give split document groups unique IDs, allow empty split groups to collapse, and promote a populated main group if the reserved primary group becomes empty. Retain an empty main drop area when all pages are floating.
Cancel via native pointer CaptureLost on Escape. Do not recreate page content or dispose controls during docking.
Update the built-in Chinese/English/Japanese guide and maintained user guide. Normal startup remains the base lens editor plus 2D viewer, not automatic analysis restoration.

representativeCapture.meaning: Actual application controls rendered to a background bitmap while a synthetic pointer hovers the native left-docking target; not optical accuracy evidence.

preservedIntermediateEvidence: dock-guidance-geometry.trx: four horizontal preview/actual size mismatches before nested document splits; vertical splits passed.
merge-empty-pane-before.trx: all four new full-width merge assertions failed (572 DIP remained instead of 1148 DIP), corrected by empty-pane collapse and primary-group promotion.

merge-empty-pane-after.trx: two reverse-merge assertions incorrectly inspected an inactive tab's detached content, rather than its live document container; harness corrected without weakening the width assertion.

dock-guidance-debug.trx: 20 passed and one headless/Skia typeface mismatch from mixing rendering backends in one test process. Ordinary tests now use the common headless drawing backend; explicit screenshot tests run Skia in isolation.

Earlier synthetic pointer tests omitted the held-left-button modifier or hit native double-tap floating when grabbing the same tab point immediately after Escape; the input harness now models an actual held drag and distinct title grab points.

The first restricted root build attempt returned exit 1 with zero compiler errors; the restricted format build host reported named-pipe permission denial. Final builds and formatting use the required local IPC permission.
countingRule: Scoped collections overlap and must not be added. Synthetic pointer inputs are delivered only to background headless windows, not the user's desktop. Geometry assertions allow up to 8 DIP for native borders and splitters; horizontal pre-fix discrepancies were approximately 190 DIP. MDI directional splitting targets its document group, not a free-positioned child rectangle.
